Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail

Class SmtpAccountMailer

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail.SmtpAccountMailer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AccountMailer
public class SmtpAccountMailer extends Object implements AccountMailer
AccountMailer that sends plain-text messages through SMTP. Subject and body come from a MessageSource resolved with the explicitly configured locale, never the platform's default. A delivery failure is reported as an AccountMailException that carries neither the address nor the token, so the calling use case rolls back whatever it stored for the message.
